name: Rothé Zombie

Pure milk-white pupil-less eyes. Visible rough dark stitching across shoulders and one cheek joining mismatched patches of worn brown-grey shaggy hide. Complete silhouette horns to hooves, coherent bovine anatomy, no token frame or decoration. Suggest the undead through white eyes, stitches and lifeless posture with minimal blood.
